This paper studies minimax estimation of the average treatment effect in a finite-alphabet observational model with binary treatment and outcome, unrestricted categorywise nuisance functions, and fixed overlap. For sufficiently large sample size nnn, the minimax mean-squared risk over the overlap-restricted iid experiment class is 1n+d2n2(log⁡n)2\frac1n+\frac{d^2}{n^2(\log n)^2}n1​+n2(logn)2d2​ up to constants depending on the overlap level. The upper bound is attained by a computable two-split hybrid estimator.
